what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Vanuatu in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 961 asylum seekers from Vanuatu, and Australia hosted 91.2% of them.
After Australia, the largest hosts are Peru, the United States and Costa Rica.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Vanuatu, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2017 at 14 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 1151, at the end of 2024, and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
